claim_ceiling: F0 is an operational lineage-response equivalence class for the tested root-change query, not metaphysical event identity.
The Stockfish positive-control pass preserves an exact witness but its probed F0 fiber is singleton; it does not establish within-Stockfish compression.
Fresh within-world congruence across six engine-worlds does not license context-free transport because pooled fresh worlds contain one prospectively observed collision.
The historical transport arm is descriptive because earlier outcomes already existed.
The single fresh cross-context collision is a counterexample to the tested context-free F0 law, not a population prevalence estimate.
No engine identity, FEN, full key, exact address, new diagnostic coordinate or post-outcome threshold may be added retroactively to rescue P1.
No chess strategy, cognition, intent or population-level causal law is authorized.
scientific_interpretation: P1 replaces P34 structural similarity with an outcome-blind lineage-response causal fiber. The fiber preserves the binding Stockfish singleton witness and is locally congruent in every fresh engine-world, but the same F0 diagnostic fiber can reverse ROOT_CHANGE across contexts, including within the same engine across fresh positions. The next object is therefore a context-indexed causal fiber field and the identification of the minimal pre-intervention conditioning basis required for transport.
successor_question: Which prospectively measurable pre-intervention context coordinates are minimally sufficient to make a lineage-response fiber's root-change relation transport across positions and engines without collapsing to position or engine identity?
